card.name: Cold or cool before clammy skin
card.fires_on: The word cold or cool (or the 'and' after it) just before 'clammy skin' in lists of overdose signs. It expects the word clammy next.

modes.label: Cold/cool before clammy
modes.description: The word cold or cool in a symptom list, right before 'clammy skin'.
modes.example: skeletal muscle flaccidity,<< cold>> and clammy skin, constricted pupils

modes.label: 'and' after cold
modes.description: The word 'and' joining cold to clammy.
modes.example: with the skin either flushed or cold<< and>> clammy; heart block and brad

card.writes: It pushes the model toward sweat-related words such as sweaty and clammy-skin terms.
card.plain: It fires on 'cold' or 'cool' when the text is about to say the skin is clammy, as in overdose symptom lists.
